name: 2steaks-skills
description: Skills and mods for Claude Code by 2Steaks.

plugins.name: learning-guardrails
plugins.description: Opt-in learning guardrails: call /learning-guardrails and it holds risky or new code until you show you understand it.

plugins.name: learning-gate
plugins.description: Enforces learning-guardrails: keeps it opt-in, blocks code edits while a checkpoint is open and pins the open question above the prompt.

plugins.name: team-deliberation
plugins.description: Stress-test an idea or decision with a panel of independent specialist subagents: blind analysis, cross-examination, fact checks and a synthesis that keeps the dissent.
